segments.text: That all beleevers are a holy and ſanctified people, and that ſanctification is a ſpirituall grace of the new Covenant, and effect of the love of God, manifeſted to the ſoule, whereby the beleever is in truth and realitie ſeparated, both in ſoule and body, from all ſinne and dead workes, through the bloud of the everlaſting Covenant, whereby he alſo preſſeth after a heavenly and Evangelicall perfection, in obedience to all the Commands, which Chriſt as head and King in this new Covenant has preſcribed to him.
